title: Terence Tao: Math 2.0 [pdf]
summary: Terence Tao's Caltech 2026 slides on 'Math 2.0' explore how AI and large language models are transforming mathematical research, from proof assistance and conjecture generation to collaborative workflows between mathematicians and AI systems. The talk examines emerging tools, verification challenges, and the evolving role of human mathematicians in an AI-augmented mathematical ecosystem.
